note: X-figure sentences in the dossier prose (design row 5, C27), owner-reviewed, never bot-written. The detector (hype_build.x_figure, mirrored in scripts/check_page.mjs) flags a sentence holding a numeral and an X term (X, x.com, twitter, tweet, repost, retweet, x_search, syndication) or an engagement term (likes, replies, views, reposts, followers, impressions, bookmarks). Each hit is keyed by item slug (null: file-level text), field path and the SHA256 of the sentence. "strip" sentences are replaced by the placeholder and listed here with digits masked (#) and handles removed, so this file does not republish them; "keep" sentences are shown as written. An unlisted hit fails CI.
